title: Nice and effective little app...
body: Nice little app for very fast note taking (written and by voice), though not the best one for large list of notes : nice look and feel (frames) with large appearance is not practical when you have to browse more than 20 notes. But I like it like that for fast note taking and sharing. Enjoy it.

title: Why no Google Keep in the iOs Sharing list?
body:
I have to open Google Keep each time I want to create a note or save something, an URL, etc. 
Why is Google Keep not in the "Share With" list in the other apps?? Like Pocket:  if there is something you want to keep you use "share"..but no Google Keep in this list.. 
What is wrong at Google regarding iOS apps???
